batch: cooperative, traceability, sensor, and stakeholder CLI temporal preflight

slices.name: cooperative asset booking timestamps
slices.contract: Reject malformed or date-only ISO values, mixed timezone-awareness, and end times not later than start before the CLI runner acquires PostgreSQL. Preserve valid ISO timestamp strings through existing dispatch.

slices.name: traceability harvest date
slices.contract: Validate canonical, real YYYY-MM-DD dates during argparse before shared runner/database acquisition; preserve valid date strings unchanged.

slices.name: sensor reading date/time
slices.contract: Reuse the canonical UTC field-reading parser to reject malformed/impossible dates, invalid times, and blank time before run_single can open PostgreSQL. Valid values remain unchanged, omitted values remain None for the existing current-date/time defaults, and parsed timestamps retain UTC interpretation.

slices.name: stakeholder engagement date and timestamps
slices.contract: Validate target_date as a canonical calendar DATE and scheduled_at/due_at as ISO timestamps with explicit timezone offsets for TIMESTAMPTZ before get_db. Preserve valid strings and omitted None values.
